verdicts.reason: Both swap the copy so it reads '$199 / New York / from', with 'from' after its price, which breaks the message. A also shrinks the Meridian logo to an illegible speck under 'from', so the brand is effectively lost, and it leaves dead space between the copy and the Book button. B keeps the logo at a readable size, but it shrinks 'from' to tiny text stuck beside the logo, crowds the logo against the suitcase wheels at the bottom, and the suitcase nearly touches the top and bottom edges. B is slightly less bad because the brand mark survives.
